text: I had a very positive experience with this clinic for hyperbaric oxygen therapy. The staff were professional, knowledgeable, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the session. So after spending countless hours in airplanes and airports I arrived in Chiang Mai Thailand completely jet lagged.  An exact 12 hour difference meant day was night and night was day to my body.  So I decided to go to Absolute Health Clinic for some hyperbaric oxygen therapy.   I must say that they have a courteous and knowledgeable staff, and doctor.  The clinic is in a nice area near the airport very comfortable inside the rooms.  The booth was equipped with a reclining chair as they pumped 95% oxygen into the pressurized space and for an hour I just breathed.  That was yesterday and last night was the best sleep I have had this trip.
It is a very nice clinic here, the treatment is good , and very good service here . I would really come back here again soon !

I went here on a recommendation from another foreigner. The treatment I received for back and neck pain was ok. I asked the doctor about hrt and he pretended to know what he was doing. I had to take 2 blood tests which were expensive because he "forgot" to do the proper blood work for hormones. So I had to pay again for more blood work even though it was their mistake. Then I was given low grade estrogen cream and progesterone cream which wasn't even the right ratio to protect my uterus. All for almost $600  USD later. Those creams were ordered off of Lazada for barely $30 usd and put into cute little syringes to look fancy. They charged me almost $400 USD for crappy low grade  creams .Then I had to pay for 2 blood tests. I have had different hrt in USA. I ACTUALLY COULD TELL THE DIFFERENCE. It did nothing for me except take money. I personally would like my money back. I went to a Gyn here at another clinic and the hormones were actually effective and only about $15 USD. Don't trust this place. They think foreigners are too stupid. I should have realized when they messed up blood work and made me pay again both times were almost $200 USD. I'm disappointed because I thought the medical professionals here we're honest. Now I learned. I value integrity especially when it comes to my personal well being and health.
